operations.title: The five-cycle infinity constant is graph-specific but lies in a carrier-compiled logarithmic period class
operations.body: C5 is exactly 4pi times a rational combination of 1,log2,log3,log5. The identically normalized four-cycle constant differs and uses 1,log2,log3.

operations.title: Exact partial-fraction evaluation and four-cycle comparison
operations.body: BigInt rational partial fractions verify simple-pole cancellation and the exact boundary expression; the C5 value agrees with independent quadrature below 4e-15.

operations.title: Benincasa classifies the cycle infinity constants
operations.body: Entry 1310: C5=4pi[-3797899/995328+(17729/2916)log2-(87/256)log3-(2225/147456)log5]. The same normalization gives C4=4pi[485/432-(1481/648)log2+(27/64)log3], so the number is graph-specific. The reusable structure is a mixed-Tate logarithmic class compiled from integer wall sizes. Six sites is the next falsifier.
